items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I played with Erskine, several club dates, I guess.

ctx.x: Yeah, became a great star just standing in front of a band. That was -- Willy was covering -- we were doing a lot of NBC broadcasts and the band was going on the road, drawing crowds, broadcasting from the Savoy. When Chick would not be in there.
I was just thinking, even though we're jumping back and forth in the '30s between Chicago and New York, did you have any escapades, any association with Erskine Tate out there in Chicago?
Yes, I worked for Erskine many times. Triangle Club, on the West Side, and then on other occasions with --
